items.description: Exactly one subject kind, as ActionPolicyBinding's subject is written.

sandbox.description: One Sandbox, resolved in the workload namespace the enforcing deployment serves (`--sandbox-namespace`). The UID pins the instance, so a Sandbox deleted and recreated under this name does not inherit the grant.

serviceAccount.description: A workload no Sandbox owns, such as a Deployment, named by the ServiceAccount its Pod runs as. Every Pod running as it is this subject and nothing ends the subject with a workload, so bind only a ServiceAccount dedicated to one.

policies.description: EgressPolicy names in the binding's namespace.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the binding contributes nothing.
